name: wall_top_window_box
description: 2-unit cutaway box window seen from straight above: protruding outer stone sill, cut wall top, wooden frame with two jambs and central mullion, two cold glass panes, protruding inner wooden sill, and separate gathered curtains layer. No rim.
anchor_note: (80, 56) is the centre of the 2x1 wall cells (x=0..159, y=16..95). Outer stone sill overhangs y=0..15 (16 px N); inner wooden sill overhangs y=96..107 (12 px S); curtains extend to y=115.

orientations.north_wall_bedroom: as drawn (outside to the N, room floor + inner sill + curtains to the S)
orientations.south_wall_porch: flip_v = true (one is a vertical flip of the other because light is strictly overhead, STYLE section 8)

three_cell_front_wall.usage: Split wall_top_window_box at y=56 into outer_half (rows 0..55: 16 px outer sill + 40 px outer wall with frame & glass) and inner_half (rows 56..119: 40 px inner wall with reveal & lip + 12 px inner sill + curtains). Place wall_top_window_box_filler (160x80, the floor of the deep opening) between outer_half and inner_half (once per extra wall cell: 2 filler copies for the 3-cell front wall).
